title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs updates
author: Priya Nair
description: Adds a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples (TypeScript/Python), and corresponding quickstart docs for the docs site. Motivation: provide developers with ready-to-run agent patterns for common RAG flows (search+filter, multi-tool orchestration, streaming tool responses) and improve discovery in the docs site. This PR includes: 1) new agent templates (JSON/YAML) for basic RAG, multi-tool RAG, and safe-fallback agent; 2) two runnable examples: redwood-examples/agents/rag/basic-agent.py and redwood-examples/agents/rag/tool_calling_example.ts; 3) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md and updates to docs/site content/quickstarts/index.md with links and screenshots; 4) integration tests for tool-calling examples and CI docs workflow adjustments. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Quickstart and reference docs - [x] Tests for example CI run - [x] Update mkdocs navigation - [x] Basic smoke test on dedicated deployment (manual) See linked Linear items for product acceptance. Changes are intentionally modular so the examples repo can be consumed independently by the quickstarts and by redwood-examples consumers.
commits: feat(rag): add three RAG agent templates and README for templates
feat(examples): add Python and TypeScript tool-calling quickstarts with sample env and instructions
docs: add quickstart page and update docs site navigation
test: add integration smoke test for tool-calling example and CI workflow updates
